title: Rock/Paper/Scissors
i
Origin: Earlier Chinese hand games; modern form developed in Japan

blocks.html: Rock/Paper/Scissors is a simultaneous-choice hand game with a circular relationship between its three options: rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, and paper beats rock. Matching choices produce a tie. No option is always strongest, so repeated rounds can involve reading habits, creating expectations, and resisting predictable patterns.

It is also used to settle everyday choices without equipment. The familiar three-sign form developed through Japanese hand-game traditions with earlier Chinese precedents, and spread internationally; it has no single commercial publisher or release date.
